WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill
  FROM orderexecutions
  GROUP BY ordersmark
), first_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS benchmark
  FROM per_order
), first_kept AS (
  SELECT p.ordersmark, p.avg_fill, p.avg_fill - b.benchmark AS first_excess
  FROM per_order AS p
  CROSS JOIN first_benchmark AS b
  WHERE p.avg_fill > b.benchmark
), second_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS benchmark
  FROM first_kept
), final_kept AS (
  SELECT f.avg_fill, f.first_excess, f.avg_fill - b.benchmark AS second_excess
  FROM first_kept AS f
  CROSS JOIN second_benchmark AS b
  WHERE f.avg_fill > b.benchmark
)
SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS avg_final_fill_quantity,
       AVG(first_excess) AS avg_first_excess,
       AVG(second_excess) AS avg_second_excess
FROM final_kept;

assumptions.assumption: Executions are grouped by ordersmark, with NULL ordersmark forming one group; AVG ignores missing fillcount values and includes zeroes. Orders whose per-order average is NULL are excluded from benchmarks and comparisons. Excesses are differences between an order's per-order average and the corresponding benchmark.
